title: Lightly Battered American Milk Fritters
description: A funky and springy American dish perfect for brunch, featuring milk and a light batter, with a dairy-free friendly option. These fritters are deep-fried to a golden brown and served hot.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a cookie scoop or spoon, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
